confidence_reason: The current source explicitly defines all pad dependencies, the paired boss targets, hazards, and death recovery, allowing a source-supported route. No retained ordinary-input route or recovery trace was available; no clear or human result is claimed.

confirmed: The visible STOP, PAC STEADY, RESCUE, and paired TARGET labels are the central route controls.
missed_mechanics: STOP halts the ferry and opens Pac’s island gate; Pac STEADY then powers the ferry, stabilizes the bridge, and opens Isp’s bridge gate; Isp RESCUE latches all supports and opens Pac’s final gate.
Gem’s paired TARGET pads require simultaneous occupation by Isp and Pac to defeat the boss; this is not merely a route marker.
The lower slime and Gem core are lethal hazards beneath the required crossings, while the bubble’s FLOAT/STICKY effects are temporary; STEADY and RESCUE each interrupt the bubble once.
The ferry’s default power cycle is overridden by the powered pad state, so the route does not require a 7-second timing window.
The two colored items are optional, owner-specific collectibles.
incorrect_inferences: The first-pass possibility that a target might control the sugar pump or open a route is not the causal link: the pads defeat Gem when both are occupied; Pac STEADY and Isp RESCUE control the ferry/bridge route.
changed_judgments: Cooperation rises from 3 to 4 because a sequence of role handoffs culminates in simultaneous hero-specific targets.
Execution rises from 2 to 3 because the source route crosses a moving ferry and an elevated bridge and requires several precise support/target placements.
Timing changes from unknown to 0: power and bridge support can be held or latched, removing the apparent ferry cycle as a mandatory window.
Hazards change from unknown to 3 because the ferry/bridge spans and lower core are lethal if support is lost; a fall resets the whole staged route.
Novelty rises from 2 to 3 because the pad/ferry lessons transfer, but paired boss-target defeat is new at this position.
Recovery changes from unknown to 3 because death reconstructs the entire room and erases all prior pad progress.
unresolved: No retained ordinary-input clear, timing trace, or death/recovery trace was available. The proposed route is source-derived, not replayed; novice interpretation of the multi-pad sequence and bubble interference remains unknown.

single_operator_note: One operator would have to hold Isp on STOP while moving Pac, switch to Pac STEADY while moving Isp over the ferry and bridge, then put both heroes on their separate TARGET pads at once and manage two exits. That multitasking cost is separate from the two-human baseline.
